rawFindings.title: Public toObject({ depopulate: true }) now returns only the root _id
rawFindings.explanation: This branch runs for any caller that passes `{ depopulate: true }` without the internal `isParent` flag. As a result, calling `doc.toObject({ depopulate: true })` on a normal top-level document returns `clone(this._id, options)` and drops all other fields, even though depopulation should only replace populated child refs with their ids.
rawFindings.suggestion: Do not treat a missing internal parent flag as permission to depopulate the root document; gate this branch on an explicit internal child/depopulate marker, and set that marker only when cloning nested populated values.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For a model with `{ name: String }`, `new User({ name: 'Alice' }).toObject({ depopulate: true })` returns just the document `_id` instead of an object containing `_id` and `name`.
